The '''1009-JuleX Reserve Battery''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser battery]] designed by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. They were usually installed on [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] such as the [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|''FireStar''-class Orbital Defense Station]].<ref name="HS" />
